title: Variables & Types
explanation: Java is statically typed: every variable has a fixed type declared up front. The common primitive types are int (whole numbers), double (decimals), boolean (true/false), and char (a single character); String holds text.
Declare a variable as: type name = value;  For example: int health = 20;
Try adding a few variables of your own below and printing them. String + anything concatenates it into text, e.g. System.out.println("health: " + health).
